message.content: {"caption":"Loop linking task proposal, environment validation, and problem solving in the Absolute Zero framework.","description":"A process diagram shows a central language model with proposer and solver roles, connected to two environment nodes. The proposer sends a task τ to an environment labeled e, f, which returns a validated problem (x, y*) and a proposal reward r^propose.
